quartz.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals or deliverables to fail. Numbered condition 1 instead derives coverage from the signed order: optional G4 cannot satisfy mandatory R8, and R3 and R5 are unrepresented. No amendment withdraws these requirements.

maple.rationale: The registered required goals G4 and G2 have current passing criteria and usable readbacks, satisfying the legacy adapter. Numbered condition 1 requires coverage of the signed order independently of the registry; mandatory R3 has no corresponding required goal, criterion, or printable checklist.

orchid.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R5 with R6. All current mandatory outcomes have required goals, passing criteria, and usable outputs. X16 concerns another order and does not bind this release.

linen.rationale: All mandatory outputs are verified, so the registry-local legacy adapter passes. However, S81 became binding before publication. Numbered condition 6 and the final transition's authority guard suppress a new success notification despite the earlier passing assessment.
